body: claimed: UMA · 2026-11-12T00:38Z · branch issue/894-thread-mill (mkinney fork, synced at v0.17.0) · plan: thread-mill tool kind (single- and multi-form) + a helical thread-milling operation (internal/external, climb/conventional, radial passes), from published machining handbooks; refusals by name for impossible geometry; may ship in slices with Refs #894

fix on issue/894-thread-mill · PR #1005 · pinned by `machining2d::thread_tests` (motion), `thread_mill::tests` (tools), `--test thread_mill`, `--test mill2d_c`, `--test mcp thread_milling_over_the_tools`, `operation::thread_op::tests` (app), `thread_mill_page_tests` / `tool_thread_mill_row::tests` (ui), six new goldens · merges at the next cut

First slice (`Refs #894`, so this issue stays open after the merge):
- Stored: `thread_mill` (multi-form) and `thread_mill_single` (single-form, `pitch_min`..`pitch`) tool kinds - library and project file, tool editor, starter catalog.
- Used: the `Thread` operation, reworked - internal threads by helical interpolation, radial passes, climb / conventional, right / left hand, single-form one turn per thread and multi-form one revolution per level; verifies clean on a modelled hole, the post gate passes, Fanuc output carries G02/G03 with Z.
- Breaking: a Thread operation no longer accepts a Tap-kind tool.

Still owed, each filed "Part of #894":
- #992 (bug, P1): an undrilled hole is not refused - the mill is fed down the axis and nothing checks an earlier operation opened the hole. Newly reachable, because no Thread operation could post before.
- #985: external threads at the operation level (the kernel cuts a boss; no boss recognition or pick yet).
- #986: the thread form in the simulation and the tool preview (today: the root cylinder / a plain cylinder).
- #987: forms beyond 60 degrees (Whitworth, taper pipe, trapezoidal) - refused today.
- #988: spring pass, tapered pass depths, depth allowance, M4 cutters.
- #989 (`MCP:`): the camcraft-mcp skill text for the new kinds and fields (the tools themselves already carry them).

Decisions and public sources: `docs/decisions/894-thread-mill.md` on the branch.
